user.title: Nexus MCP: Inference Provider
user.description:
Select the AI brain for Nexus MCP. Google Gemini Free Tier and local Ollama are 100% free.

• **Google Gemini**: Get a free API key at [Google AI Studio](https://aistudio.google.com/app/apikey).
• **Ollama Local**: Free & private, running locally on your hardware.
• **OpenAI / Custom**: Bring your own key.

gemini.title: Google Gemini (Free Tier)

ollama.title: Ollama Local (Qwen 2.5 Coder)
ollama.description: Connect to your local Ollama instance running Qwen Coder.

data_description.model: Model tag to use (e.g. qwen2.5-coder:7b or qwen2.5-coder:latest).
